title: Count Divisors
problem: Read one positive integer N. Print how many positive whole numbers divide N exactly, with no remainder. Count both 1 and N itself. For example, 12 gives 6 (the divisors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 12) and 7 gives 2 (1 and 7).
starter_code:
# Read one positive integer N.
# Print how many positive whole numbers divide N with no remainder.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Think about which numbers could possibly divide N, and how you can test one candidate at a time.
hints.2: Loop through every candidate from 1 up to N itself, and count the ones that leave no remainder when they divide N. The % operator gives the remainder.

failure_explanation: Count every whole number from 1 up to and including N that leaves no remainder when it divides N. A common slip is to stop the loop one short, so N itself is missed, or to count only the divisors up to half of N. Also make sure each divisor is counted once, even when N is a perfect square.
